Below is a list of hobby and interest groups hosted by the IPC in the Astropolis region. All publicly accessible.
You can search for them directly through the IPC's information network, or contact the group owner to join.

...
Astro Kitty
Cat Lover Group

Astro Puppy
Dog Lover Group

Astropolis Telepathic Spider
Groups 1–5 are full. Please join Group 6.
A cozy little chat room for the telepathic spider community. Membership turnover is pretty high.

Astropolis Zatzka
Executive Chat. Restricted to P35+ employees. Identity verification required to join.

AstroBloom
Group 2 is full. Please join Group 3
A discussion group for horticulture and botany enthusiasts.
※ Discussion is limited to non-sapient species only. Please do not use this as a lifestyle vlog for plant-based races.
※ Fans of alien VStreamer "Sparxie" are prohibited from joining. Discussions about bananas are also strictly prohibited.

I Can't Take Astropolis Anymore
All 15 groups are full. No new groups will be created. Please wait for a member to leave or resign. Unless otherwise noted, the same applies below.
Intergalactic Travel & Exchange Group.
※ Despite numerous complaints about the group name, it will not be changed for the time being, per the founder's insistence.
※ Please try to avoid venting work-related frustrations in the group chat.
※ Exercise caution with group-buy listings in the chat, especially those involving phrases like "World-Ending Adventure," "Experience the Trailblaze," or "Good News for Banana Enthusiasts."

AstroFlea
Spots available in Groups 2 and 3
Barter & Trade Group
※ Most members are employees who distrust the IPC's in-house secondhand marketplace, "Fleapit," including, notably, the very team that developed it.

AstroShock
All 15 groups are full.
Pan-Entertainment News & Discussion Group.
※ Please ensure compliance when chatting. Do not share sensitive information such as idol schedules, last fiscal year's revenue, etc.
※ To prevent message flooding, posts in this group are subject to a long cooldown period.

AstroRace
Groups 1–8 are full, please join Group 9
A chat group for racing event enthusiasts.
※ If you've suffered losses from sports betting, please keep your comments to yourself. Active drivers and racecars may be present in this group.

Astropolis truly is a wonderful place, and what makes it so wonderful is
Secondhand Sublet/Resale Housing Exchange Group

AstroMyriad
Escape Room / Offline Puzzle Game Discussion Group

Astro Aeon
Pathstrider Fan Club & Exchange Group
※ Please refrain from any pointless fawning over individuals wanted by the IPC.

Astro Stars
Stargazers and astronomy enthusiasts group

The group founder of Astro Anglers once reeled in a 64-pounder fish. Check the pinned message for the photo.
A gathering place for fishing enthusiasts.

Astro Frenzy
A group chat dedicated to going unhinged and messing with "Servis"

Astro Arita
A fan community for Mr. Arita and Kenneth Arita

Astro Roast Duck
Xianzhou Gourmet Exchange Group, managed by the owner of the Astropolis's rotating restaurant

My Computer
Relationship and Lifestyle Exchange Group.
※ Originally named "Astrolife," this chat group has consistently topped the charts for least active group chats year after year. After a Punklordian hacker distorted its name to "My Computer," the group experienced a feverish surge in activity, and the name has stuck ever since.

When Will Pier Point Explode
A communication group for anti-IPC activities and related organizations. Complete identity verification to receive regular activity funding sponsored by the IPC.

...

The list is being updated in real time. For group formation requests, please contact the Astropolis Employee Care Service Center.
